subject: Mahindra Scorpio-N
_angle: Option 3 — Value shock (how much you get + Creta rivalry)

segments.text: For what some pay for a fancy hatchback, the Scorpio-N hands you 203 horses and seven seats.
The diesel four-by-four twists out 400 Newton-metres — enough to tow your problems clean away.
It opens near thirteen-and-a-half lakh and climbs to a loaded, twelve-speaker, driver-assist top model — still a bargain.
More muscle, more seats, more toys, less money — maths this good should come with a warning. Hit like if you're sold.
Scorpio-N or Creta — sensible or serious? Comment 1 or 2. Like, share, subscribe. Hatchback money, remember?
